title: Baked Fish with Zesty American Glaze
description: A flavorful and moist fish dish topped with a zesty American-inspired glaze. Quick and easy to make, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the fish fillets on the baking sheet.
Drizzle the zesty sauce over the fish fillets.
Mix the mayonnaise and burger seasoning, and brush the mixture over the fish.
Bake for 8-10 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve with a dollop of sour cream on top.
Garnish with chopped herbs, if desired.
